checklist.why: Replaces native select; ChoiceList multi named
Two to four outcomes: the Choice field named as the alternative
Trigger parts named; the sheet (title, search, tabs, selected tray, footer) is not
Only single exists in the DS; the multi and nested pickers that screens need are unspecified
Error, loading and empty "not drawn"; disabled dims (forbidden by the DS law)
Trigger 47px in the preview; 40px (Care, Method) and 44px (Conditions) on screens
No cap on options before search or nesting
No long-value truncation; the multi trigger joins names with commas
listbox/option roles, but no keyboard model for nested levels
#bdc7b6 and raw px; inspection CSS overrides the trigger six times (12px font, 40-44px)
The Conditions trigger on record-health has no visible label; placeholder "Choose ..." instead of "Select"
The condition sheet shows a header back arrow, a close X and footer Back together, plus Done
The real multi picker breaks: after the first tick the list disappears

variants.name: single (flat/sectioned)
findings: Trigger height is 40, 44, 47 or 48px across screens because of host overrides
Placeholder copy varies: Select / Choose method / Choose unit / Select medicine

variants.name: multi (condition picker)
findings: An unclosed <details> in bulkHealthPicker (ux/system/inspection-astra-concept.js:699) swallows the catalogue: after one tick the list vanishes behind "1 selected"; opening it shows the ticked row twice and the list clipped
Four exits: header back arrow, header close X, footer Back and Done
Search covers only the open group: "fev" in General appearance finds nothing and offers Add "fev"
The trigger is a fork (.bulk-condition-button) with no label, and writes the names joined by commas instead of "n selected"
Checkbox on the left; a native disclosure triangle

variants.name: nested single (medicine picker)
findings: The category level is navigate rows; no path is written back ("Antibiotics / Amoxicillin")

findings.text:
The multi condition picker loses its list on the first selection: `
...` is never closed, so .health-catalog renders inside the collapsed
.
findings.fix: Close the tag (``). Better: replace the disclosure with a "1 selected" ChoiceList navigate row that opens a review level.

findings.text: Screens need multi and nested pickers, but the component defines only single and sends callers to ChoiceList multi, so every host builds its own sheet.
findings.fix: Give PickerField the sheet, with the variants single, multi, cascade and cascade-multi (see proposals), and draw the rows with ChoiceList.

findings.text: The condition sheet stacks four exits (back arrow, close X, Back, Done).
findings.fix: Show the header back arrow only while a level is open; keep footer Back (leaves and keeps the draft) + "Done · n"; drop the X.

findings.text: Host CSS forks the trigger (12px text, 40-44px), and Conditions uses a separate .bulk-condition-button with no label.
findings.fix: Delete the six .st-picker-trigger overrides in inspection-astra-concept.css. Render Conditions as pickerField({label:"Conditions", display:"2 selected"}), with the trigger at min-height 48.

findings.text: Search covers only the open group, so a symptom in another group reads as missing and invites a custom duplicate.
findings.fix: Search the whole catalogue (both kinds) and show each hit with its path as meta ("Symptoms · General appearance").

findings.text: `disabled` dims the trigger, which the DS law forbids; placeholder copy drifts from "Select".
findings.fix: Remove disabled. Default the placeholder to "Select", and to "None" for multi.

proposals.name: PickerField multi
proposals.why: Flat or sectioned multi-select: trailing checkboxes (ChoiceList multi), footer Back + "Done · n selected", trigger shows "n selected" or "None", and the selected items as a "n selected" row at the top, not a <details>

proposals.name: PickerField cascade
proposals.why: The ADM/Vant/TDesign Cascader model: one level at a time, a step row of the chosen levels that can be tapped to go back, auto-advance on pick, and the path written back to the trigger ("Antibiotics / Amoxicillin")

proposals.name: PickerField cascade-multi
proposals.why: The condition picker: kind (Diseases/Symptoms) to group to ticked leaves. A step row replaces the tabs and the back-arrow header; group rows carry "n selected" meta; search spans the whole tree with path meta; ticks across branches persist; "Done · n"
